task.title: Apply resilience and recovery steps when keydef-based pop-ups fail
task.shortdesc: Use repeatable recovery actions to restore keyword pop-up behavior after configuration or content changes.

step.cmd: Clear build artifacts (temp directories, output folders, editor caches) to remove stale resolved-key state.
Validate that all referenced files exist and are readable, then fix any broken URIs in keydefs or topicrefs.
Create a minimal reproduction: one root map with one keydef and one topic using <keyword keyref="...">, then confirm expected behavior.
Compare the minimal reproduction against the failing project to identify the first configuration/content difference that breaks pop-ups.
Roll back recent changes to maps, filtering profiles, or plugins, then reapply changes incrementally while testing after each step.
Record the final working configuration (root map used, transform scenario, plugin list, filtering settings) as a recovery checklist.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
